2. The petitioner has filed an application under Section 439 Cr.PC with prayer for bail as he is in custody since 01.04.2023 in connection with Lakhipur P.S. Case No. 113/2023 under Sections 420/406/384 IPC corresponding in GR Case No. 487/2023.

sentences.text: 1 3. Heard Mr. P. Borthakur, learned Addl. P.P. for the State of Assam.
4. The FIR unfolds that an amount of Rs. 12,000/- was paid to the petitioner by the informant for mutation of land under the Bashundhara Scheme but the land was not mutated under the said Scheme.
5. It is submitted at the Bar that the petitioner is a petition writer and he had accepted fees for mutation of land of the informant.
When he failed to mutate the land under the Bashundhara Scheme he returned the amount of Rs. 3,500/- to the informant.
6. I have considered the submission that the petitioner has been in custody since 01.04.2023.
Presumably investigation may have progressed to some extent.
The petitioner is a local resident.
7. Considering all aspects, petition is allowed.

The petitioner is enlarged on bail of Rs. 30,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the CJM, Goalpara under the conditions that - i. the petitioner will refrain from such activities with which he is alleged; and ii. the petitioner will not tamper with the evidence.
